unit: checkouts that emptied the basket and created no order
note: Ordering API answers 200 even when the order was not written (Ordering.API/Apis/OrdersApi.cs:155-166), and the WebApp empties the basket without reading the answer (WebApp/Services/OrderingService.cs:12-18; WebApp/Services/BasketState.cs:107-108)

unit: baskets still holding items already ordered
note: Both deletes failed; the customer may order the items twice (WebApp/Services/BasketState.cs:107-108; Basket.API/IntegrationEvents/EventHandling/OrderStartedIntegrationEventHandler.cs:14)

unit: orders held in Submitted past the grace period
note: Every poll publishes again for orders still Submitted (OrderProcessor/Services/GracePeriodManagerService.cs:54-61)
A lost or failed message is not sent again; nothing polls AwaitingValidation (EventBusRabbitMQ/RabbitMQEventBus.cs:170-180; OrderProcessor/Services/GracePeriodOrdersRepository.cs:27)

unit: orders confirmed with an item the catalogue does not hold
note: The check skips a product it cannot find, so the order is confirmed (Catalog.API/IntegrationEvents/EventHandling/OrderStatusChangedToAwaitingValidationIntegrationEventHandler.cs:17-24)

unit: orders stranded in AwaitingValidation after their stock was rejected
orders stranded in StockConfirmed, not paid
note: A lost payment request or result is not sent again (PaymentProcessor/IntegrationEvents/EventHandling/OrderStatusChangedToStockConfirmedIntegrationEventHandler.cs:32; EventBusRabbitMQ/RabbitMQEventBus.cs:170-180)

unit: order totals not collected for orders stranded in StockConfirmed
note: Value blocked: the order total (Ordering.Domain/AggregatesModel/OrderAggregate/Order.cs:185) is not taken while the order waits

unit: orders stranded in StockConfirmed after a failed payment
cancel requests that fail, so the order goes ahead
note: The customer gets an error and must try again (Ordering.API/Apis/OrdersApi.cs:41-46). A cancel that lands while payment is in flight leaves the order Cancelled and the payment result ignored (Ordering.Domain/AggregatesModel/OrderAggregate/Order.cs:121); with a real gateway that would be money taken for a cancelled order

unit: paid orders whose stock was not reduced
note: Later stock checks confirm against stock already sold (Catalog.API/Model/CatalogItem.cs:64-67; Catalog.API/IntegrationEvents/EventHandling/OrderStatusChangedToPaidIntegrationEventHandler.cs:13-20)

unit: paid orders whose subscribers were not told
note: Retried up to 3 times on a transient failure by the standard resilience handler (Webhooks.API/Program.cs:3), then not sent again; response not read (Webhooks.API/Services/WebhooksSender.cs:13-33)
Nothing moves a Paid order but a person's call (Ordering.API/Apis/OrdersApi.cs:12)
